live_workflows.claude_web: A short real reply finished in a background browser tab and produced one Ready card with the same conversation identity.
live_workflows.chatgpt_web: A short real web reply produced one Ready card without requiring an observed stream. Open reached the exact conversation.
live_workflows.chatgpt_desktop: The new bounded reader verified a terminal reply from a user-created desktop test chat. A second post-install desktop action was reported but did not appear in the current account metadata; its full live workflow is unverified.
live_workflows.review_restart: The Claude and ChatGPT web test cards remained Reviewed after a normal app quit and reopen. Renaming the Claude test did not produce another reply alert.
live_workflows.usage: Both providers displayed fresh readings and whole numbers with aligned rows in the installed app.
live_workflows.final_build: Build54 started with every source connected, fresh whole-number usage, saved test reviews, and no re-alert of the verified unchanged transcript.
live_workflows.review_recovery: Two acknowledgments were restored only where the pre-update backup proved unchanged reviewed transcript content and unchanged owner review state. A repeat read-only audit after restart matched zero unresolved rows.

limitations: Account readers require the matching existing sign-in on this Mac and use provider interfaces that can change.
Discovery is bounded to 100 recent conversations per provider; ChatGPT status checks are bounded to 256 identities. Latest-turn reads are limited to 3 MiB.
If a first-seen ChatGPT reply began before monitoring and has no provider finish timestamp or prior reply baseline, completion can remain unconfirmed.
Provider errors and rate limits can temporarily delay status or usage readings.
This Developer ID engineering build has no new notarization and is separate from the App Store candidate.
